messages:
Ashley: Quick async — building the ownership "ladder" and dependency roster for the Ironbridge private rollout. Need a single place we can point the customer and PMs. Who owns: network egress, certs, image sync, registry access, KMS, canary plan, onprem smoke tests? I started a rough mapping below, pls correct and add owners.

Michael: I'll take infra rollout coordination. Draft owners: network -> Jin, certs -> Sasha, images/registry -> Marco, KMS/key mgmt -> Lina, QA/canary -> Michael (me). Does that align?

Jin: yes for network. Quick note: Ironbridge requires static egress IPs for their firewall allowlist. We're exposing two ranges from the onprem gateway: 198.51.100.16/28 and 198.51.100.32/28. Need ops to confirm NAT assignment and provide expected FQDNs.

Sasha: cert update: customer will provide root CA bundle tomorrow. We still need confirmation on whether we can use our intermediate or they require their CA chain only. Also need SAN list for service names (api.internal, registry.internal).

Marco: image sync plan: we'll rsync signed images from our staging registry to Ironbridge jumpbox, then load into their airgapped registry. Need GPG signing key export and a path for image digests verification. I have a WIP script, ping me for access.

Lina: KMS plan: customers want HSM-backed keys. We have the integration tested but need a KMS key alias from Ironbridge (format: arn:aws:kms:... or onprem HSM serial). Who's collecting that info?

Michael: Action items so far (please ack):
- Jin: confirm NAT IP assignment and final ranges by EOD (owner: Jin)
- Sasha: confirm CA bundle vs intermediate + SAN list (owner: Sasha)
- Marco: provide signed-image export procedure + GPG pubkey (owner: Marco)
- Lina: collect customer KMS alias/serial + HSM handshake (owner: Lina)
- Michael: craft canary test plan and tail the first rollout (owner: Michael)

Jin: acked. One more network note — customer asked for NAT fallback if primary ISPs fail. We should add a simple failover doc and an egress healthcheck. Sample ACL snippet for their firewall they asked for:```
# allow our egress pool to their firewall
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 198.51.100.16/28 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
iptables -A OUTPUT -p tcp -d 198.51.100.32/28 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
```

Sasha: acked. I'll ping the customer contact for SANs now. ETA for CA bundle verification: tomorrow 9am PT.

Marco: I uploaded the prototype rsync + verification script to the infra repo, PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/PR-4423. Please review — it contains the GPG export step and a verification hook that checks digest signatures. Needs 1-2 reviewers for merge.

Ashley: Pinging for code review: @Sasha @Lina can you review PR-4423? It's the transfer piece; Sasha you need to confirm cert naming will match. Lina you need to validate KMS handshake step in the script.

Lina: I'll take the PR today, but I need an explicit test plan from Michael for the onprem smoke so I can run KMS flows in staging.

Michael: Working on the canary plan now, will post checklist by 1500 PT. Plan will include: 1) deploy to isolated tenant, 2) run 10 synthetic calls/min for 30m, 3) validate latency and token cost, 4) fallback to hosted model if errors > 1% within window.

deploy-bot: Canary pipeline triggered for Ironbridge:canary-2026-03-18. Stages: build -> image-sync -> smoke -> perf-check. Current status: build ✅, image-sync queued.

Ashley: Nice. Final ask — please confirm owners in this thread (reply with just "ack" and owner initials) so I can lock the roster for the handoff doc. We'll convert this to the formal runbook after owners ack.

Jin: ack (Jin) :white_check_mark:

Sasha: ack (Sasha) :white_check_mark:

Marco: ack (Marco) :white_check_mark: uploaded PR link above

Lina: ack (Lina) — will review PR after Michael posts test plan

Michael: ack (Michael) — test plan by 1500 PT

Ashley: thanks all. I'll assemble the roster + blockers list and push to the customer playbook. If anything slides, drop updates here. :rocket:
